authority.source: WTW CANON REGISTRIES — 1999 START v3.3 WORKING RECONCILIATION
authority.provenance: Derived site-view snapshot. Drive remains immutable-ID authority; this is not a second master ledger.

visibility_notes: Display city/locality and travel node for every track.
Five boundary cases have reliable regional travel nodes but dual municipality/place precision remains provisional.
Eight fictional WTW tracks have explicitly proposed travel localities.
All 139 race editions without a Track_ID in the historical calendar are inactive or quarantined; do not silently assign them.

tracks.name: Delaware Park
tracks.boundary_note: Official address is Wilmington; access/location is commonly described at Stanton. Use Wilmington node until parcel-level boundary is finalized.

tracks.name: Golden Gate Fields
tracks.boundary_note: Property spans Albany and Berkeley; majority is in Albany. Use Albany as travel node pending parcel-level rule.

tracks.name: Suffolk Downs
tracks.boundary_note: Historic property spans East Boston and Revere. Clubhouse/track access anchor is East Boston; preserve both municipalities.

tracks.name: Great Lakes Downs
tracks.boundary_note: Racing authority used a Muskegon postal address; parcel evidence places the site in Fruitport Township. Use Muskegon travel node pending municipal-parcel normalization.

tracks.boundary_note: 1999-era original Evangeline Downs location; later relocation to Opelousas must not overwrite historical node.
